explication: wacli is a scriptable terminal client for WhatsApp. Its main workflow pairs a linked device, syncs WhatsApp data into a local searchable SQLite index, then lets people and scripts inspect or change messages, chats, contacts, groups, and media. The graph also includes the separate WhatsApp session store, history and media sync, and optional webhook delivery. Some command implementations were not sampled, so their internal call paths are not asserted; capability links follow the README where noted.
